newsitem.title: USA: CME traders call USDA quarterly hog report bullish.
newsitem.headline: CME traders call USDA quarterly hog report bullish.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange traders said Friday's U.S. Agriculture Department's Hogs and Pigs report was bullish for CME live hog futures with hog contracts expected to open 0.50 to 1.00 cent per lb higher Monday.
Although USDA's figures were very close to analysts' expectations, traders said USDA's numbers indicated hog supplies will remain tight into next year.
